india_trends.title: Kalshi ends Donald Trump Jr's advisory contract due to Polymarket conflict
india_trends.summary: Prediction-market platform Kalshi has ended Donald Trump Jr.’s advisory role by mutual agreement after his venture-capital firm, 1789 Capital, increased its investment in rival Polymarket. Discussions began after 1789 Capital led Polymarket’s latest funding round, according to a Kalshi spokesperson.

india_trends.title: ‘Extraordinarily difficult period’: Nvidia's new CEO Kress reassures staff after Jensen Huang's exit | Read full email
india_trends.summary: Nvidia's interim CEO Colette Kress has reassured employees after Jensen Huang's exit, calling it an ‘extraordinarily difficult period’. In her first email, she thanked staff for their resilience, expressed confidence in the company's future and urged them to move forward together.

india_trends.title: Chinese traders stay confident of Nvidia GPU supply despite Jensen Huang scandal as prices ease
india_trends.summary: Nvidia announced that Jensen Huang had resigned as president, chief executive and board member with immediate effect after the board accepted his resignation. The Chinese traders’ calm view of supply, sits against this sudden leadership change at the world’s leading AI chip maker.

india_trends.title: Civil aviation minister announces technical trilateral committee involving India, Oman, UAE

india_trends.title: The Sunil Mittal interview: Airtel debt-free by 2029. Buybacks next?

india_trends.title: Paytm shares at ₹1,925, close in on IPO listing-day high after 100% rally from March lows. What drove the recovery?
india_trends.summary: Paytm shares rose 7.3% to ₹1,925, their highest close since listing in 2021, amid optimism that merchant discount rate charges could lift margins. The company reported September-quarter profit of ₹226 crore, while mutual fund ownership reached a record 21.17%.

india_trends.title: Laurus Labs, Gland Pharma, Piramal, Divi's Labs: 4 drug manufacturing stocks rally up to 89% in 6 months - Upside ahead?
india_trends.summary: Pharma stocks, particularly CDMO companies, have surged over the past six months amid optimism about quarterly results. Laurus Labs led with an 88.64% gain, followed by Gland Pharma at 80.36%, Divi’s Laboratories at 72.35% and Piramal Pharma at 38.65%.&nbsp;
